stateKeys.name: ticketCount
stateKeys.type: integer >= 0, tickets gathered for the brief

stateKeys.name: reason
stateKeys.type: string, why the run ended without posting ('' otherwise)

specialRules.name: stale-completions-reject
specialRules.note: A tool result arriving in any state other than the one that awaits it is an observable rejection (post == pre), never a fault. This is what makes the agent's at-least-once reporting safe.
specialRules.whenAction: TICKETS_READY | TICKETS_FAILED | DRAFT_READY | APPROVED | DENIED | POST_DONE | POST_FAILED

specialRules.name: no-empty-brief
specialRules.note: TICKETS_READY with count == 0 ends the run in 'denied' rather than drafting and posting an empty brief.

noOpRule: An action that does not apply in the current state is reject(reason) - an observable no-op with post == pre.
